newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shougang Tech up on bonus warrant issue.
newsitem.headline: Shougang Tech up on bonus warrant issue.

text.p: Shares of telephones and power cords maker Shougang Concord Technology Holdings Ltd surged on Friday on buying fueled by a bonus warrant issue, brokers said.
"Speculation that the shares can edge up towards the warrant's strike price (at HK$0.6), fueled speculative demand," one broker said.
The shares rose HK$0.045 or 9.28 percent to an intraday high of HK$0.53 in early afternoon on volume of 18.23 million shares.
The company which posted a 12.8 percent interim net rise to HK$15.09 million on Thursday, proposed an issue of one bonus warrant for every six shares. -- HK Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
